heading: Photo Identity Document
page_text_first_1200: Jump to content An official website of the United States government Here's how you know My Account Resources Sign Out Skip to main content I-131, Application for Travel Documents, Parole Documents Getting Started Client Information Upload PDF Evidence 2" x 2" Photo of you Photo Identity Document I-797 Notice of Action I-797C Notice of Action Additional Evidence Review & Submit Photo Identity Document All applications must include a copy of an official photo identity document showing your photo, name, and date of birth. (Examples: Your current Employment Authorization Document, if available; a valid government-issued driver's license; passport identity page; Form I-551, Permanent Resident Card; or any other official identity document.) The copy must clearly show the photo and identity information. NOTE: Form I-94 Arrival-Departure Record is not acceptable as a photo identity document. File upload requirements Clear and readable. Accepted file formats: JPEG, JPG or PNG No encrypted or password-protected files. If your documents are in a foreign language, upload a full English translation and the translator's certification with each original document. Accepted file name characters: En

_note: Page title 'USCIS | Evidence - Photo Identity Document'. Accept list byte-identical to the photo page ('image/jpeg,.jpeg,.png,.jpg'), multiple=true, metadata cap maxNumberOfFiles=1. No PDF accepted here, which is a trap: a client's passport scan is very often a PDF.
